{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Sleight'' boxes are hardly state of the art for smugglers these days. It's almost as if they wanted to be caught.|[[Hal Horn]], to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="ST" />}}
A '''sleight box''' was a seemingly ordinary-looking cargo container that could be a variety of sizes<ref name="PSG" /> and could be made of [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]].<ref name="ST" /> The boxes had a built-in, low-powered [[Repulsor coil|repulsorlift coil]] matrix and power supply in the bottom casing. A compensating [[c-board]] helped the [[Repulsor field|repulsorfield]] to neutralize the weight of anything inside the box, giving the impression that it was empty.<ref name="PSG" />

The deception could hide anything from [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to simply air from [[Customs official/Legends|customs officials]], but by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] most [[Customs droid/Legends|customs droids]] knew what to look for in countering the smuggler design.<ref name="ST" /> [[Ecls Industries]] produced a sleight box during the Galactic Civil War designed as the [[R-Coil Crate]].<ref name="PSG" />
